item.title: [Sistemas / Cloud] USN-8686-1: openCryptoki vulnerabilities
item.description:
🚨 USN-8686-1: openCryptoki vulnerabilities
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Ubuntu
Fonte: https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/rss.xml
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
It was discovered that primitive decoders in openCryptoki produced integer underflows when the encoded length was zero. An attacker could possibly use this issue to trigger out-of-bounds reads. (CVE-2026-40253) It was discovered that openCryptoki incorrectly handled symlinks. An attacker in the token-group could possibly use this issue to achieve privilege escalation or access sensitive information.
Link: https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8686-1

item.title: [Sistemas / Cloud] USN-8687-1: p11-kit vulnerabilities
item.description:
🚨 USN-8687-1: p11-kit vulnerabilities
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Ubuntu
Fonte: https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/rss.xml
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
It was discovered that p11-kit incorrectly handled certain RPC messages. A local attacker could use this issue to cause p11-kit to crash, resulting in a denial of service. (CVE-2026-13757) It was discovered that p11-kit incorrectly handled nested attribute decoding on 32-bit systems. A local attacker could use this issue to cause p11-kit to crash, resulting in a denial of service.
Link: https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8687-1
